name: Clemenceau (R98) as completed 1961, eight 100 mm (js/hero/fr_navy_early.js clemenceau("e60"); Foch drawn the same)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'Clemenceau-class aircraft carrier' (read by the builder of js/hero/fr_navy_early.js, 2026-11): 265 m overall, 51.2 m overall beam, draught 8.6 m; the landing area 165.5 x 29.5 m at 8 deg

references.name: [K1] FS Clem plan1, starboard profile drawing
references.note: Flight deck after tip px 40, forward tip px 1575 = the published 265 m: 5.79 px/m; the boot-top (waterline) row 370, the flight-deck edge row 272 (16.9 m; re-read by a column scan at px 100, batch 4), keel row ~420 (8.6 m, the published draught: a second dimension, agrees within 2 px). X = (px - 40) / 5.79 - 132.5, Z = (370 - py) / 5.79. The drawing is light grey on a light textured ground with numbered leader lines over the island, so its dark-line mask is not a clean silhouette: kept as a reference for the reviewer and the overlay, NOT gated (exact false); the island and mast heights are hand readings (landmarks). Readings: island d 112 - 166, main block to 31.1, bridge 37.8, mast head 58.7 at d 150 (a column scan finds the pole tip at px 905 - 910, rows 22 - 30, z 58.7 - 60.1), the DRBV 23 bedstead (8) z 41.5 - 47.5 at d 136 - 145, the 100 mm sponsons (1) at d 24, 41 and 193, 209, boat recesses d 47 - 77 and 167 - 187, the deck-edge lift (3) lowered at hangar level px 575 - 665 (d 92.4 - 108), z 8.6 - 14.7.

references.name: [K3] FS Clemenceau (R98) side view, starboard broadside afloat
references.note: For the reviewer: a long-range starboard broadside, slightly off the beam (the stern is nearer): the stepped island with the radome low at its after end, the tall pole mast with its yards, the thin flight-deck overhang over open galleries, the strongly flared bow, the boat and lift openings in the hull side. Deck edge 16.9 m amidships at [K1]'s scale (cross-check). Perspective: not measured for stations.

references.name: [K2] Foch (R99) from astern and above, 1982
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'French carrier Foch (R99) aerial view aft 1982.jpeg'
references.note: The plan from astern (sister ship): the 8 deg angled deck to port with its white edge lines and dashed centre line, the island on its starboard sponson with the radome forward, the deck-edge lift abaft the island, the forward lift to starboard, 100 mm mounts on the four quarters, the narrow bow. Not to scale (oblique).

references.name: [K4] F-14As over Foch (R99), from port and above
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Grumman F-14A Tomcats of VF-14 fly over French aircraft carrier Foch (R99) ... (6451896).jpg'
references.note: Oblique from the port bow quarter: the angled deck's port sponson, the round-down aft, the gallery openings under the deck along the port side, the island's tiers.
